gen-dafont-bloody-gf-scope-one: Commanding from the first glance, Bloody swells into big round lowercase bowls. But where Bloody is best at making noise, Scope One is best at refined, traditional text with counters spilling open.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-slabo-13px: Bloody rolls out big round lowercase bowls with a commanding, bloody swagger. Slabo 13px, a serif with large open counters and clear openings in rounded letters, gives that loudness a bookish, dignified place to land.
gen-dafont-bloody-instrument-sans: Big round lowercase bowls give Bloody its commanding look, while the sans-serif Instrument Sans never varies its stroke weight. Giving Bloody the larger size lets its bowls do the shouting.
gen-dafont-bloody-inter: Inter moves along like a smooth tube, its big counters breathing open in a tall lowercase with no stroke contrast. Bloody is best at commanding, Inter at carrying words.
gen-dafont-bloody-mulish: Mulish reads modern and approachable, its apertures open like a horseshoe magnet. And across a full page its large x-height and short ascenders keep every line easygoing, a sans-serif quietly under Bloody.
gen-dafont-bloody-rubik: Bloody stamps big round lowercase bowls across the line with commanding force. And Rubik, a sans-serif with lowercase that looks big beside capitals, keeps small text clear and soft underneath.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-fauna-one: Extra-wide spacing between characters, with no weight shift along any curve, gives Bushcraft its expressive, artistic stretch. Fauna One brings the pair's best quality, a literary dignity from its tall middle band and shallow ascenders.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-glegoo: Expressive from the first letter, Bushcraft draws closed shapes with extra-wide spacing. Its single, neon-tube track is what Bushcraft does best, while Glegoo, a refined text serif, does best with big counters and unclosed curves.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-hanuman: Bushcraft draws every glyph with an unmodulated line and closed, expressive letters. But shrink the heading and its lines turn timid, while Hanuman, high-waisted and refined, grows stiff if made large.
